newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Aug trade deficit narrows to $228 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Aug trade deficit narrows to $228 mln.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit narrowed to a provisional $228 million in August from $271 million in July, and compared to $335 million in August 1995, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
Exports increased 13.9 percent to a provisional $655 million in August from $575 million in July, and 18.7 percent compared with $552 million in August 1995.
Imports increased by 4.4 percent to $883 million in August from $846 million in July and decreased by 0.4 percent against $887 million in August 1995.
The trade gap in the first two months of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) narrowed to a provisional $500 million from $630 million in the year-ago period.
Main exports were cotton yarn, fabrics, garments and rice. Main imports were machinery, petroleum products and chemicals.
